prerequisites: An own opinion and enjoyment of discussion are essential for this module
Recommended prior knowledge in the basics of AI
An understanding of social and ecological contexts

learning_outcomes.text: The module expands students' knowledge by enabling them to deeply understand and critically question the multifaceted social, moral, and ecological impacts of AI technologies. By addressing topics such as fairness and bias in algorithms, data protection, and the sustainability of AI systems, they learn how to handle AI technologies responsibly and ethically in their future professional practice.
Students will be qualified to transfer ethical awareness and sustainable approaches into AI practice, thereby enabling them to deal responsibly with AI technologies in various professional contexts.

By focusing on ethics and sustainability in AI, the module promotes the development of innovative approaches and technologies that not only overcome technical challenges but also prioritize ethical guidelines and ecological sustainability, thereby paving the way for thoughtful and future-proof AI innovations.

This module strengthens students' scientific self-understanding by guiding them to recognize and internalize the importance of ethical considerations and sustainability principles in the research and development of AI. At the same time, it promotes their professionalism, as they learn to deal responsibly with the social, ecological, and moral dimensions of their work, making them prudent and ethically acting professionals in their future professional environment.

syllabus_topics: Moral and social implications of AI
Protection of sensitive information in AI applications
assessment_rules: The graded assessment is a presentation of approximately 20 minutes, with an accompanying elaboration of about 5 pages per person.
